notes: Connect by code: after sending, Family Admin checks the screen or computer actually picked it up, and says so – or tells you to check the code

Setup website: tabs along the top – First-time setup, Screen layout, Reconfigure, Settings, then Family, Notes, Lists and Widgets. A computer that isn’t connected yet gets a choice: first-time setup, or connect this computer

The licence email and setup explain in plain English how it works (your data stays in your own Google account, reached only with your private access code) and what each step does, including what an API key is
Family Admin is described as for adults
